title: deepask art-styles registry
description: The artistic-genre axis for deepask image formats (capability deepask v1.2-image). Orthogonal to the brand --style design-systems registry. A genre carries composition/material/mood + a SECONDARY accent + display-headline character ONLY — never a structured brand palette (additionalProperties:false forbids a `colors`/`background` key, enforcing the merge precedence brand > genre, @cto Phase-5 R5).

id.description: kebab id; may start with a digit; no dots.

seed_id.description: Provenance: original id in the 80-style seed corpus.

secondary_palette.description: SECONDARY accent guidance ONLY (prose). The brand --style owns the core palette; this decorates around it. Renamed from the seed's `colors` to make subordination structural.

display_type.description: Display-headline character ONLY (prose). Brand owns body type; legibility (incl. VN diacritics) outranks this.

assets.description: THE illustration lever — the concrete objects/textures/lighting/medium the model paints. No brand-axis counterpart; this is what makes a genre look illustrated, not 'text on a gradient'.
